summary: Amazon has upgraded Alexa with generative AI responses that are longer, more conversational, and harder to interrupt. There is no dedicated off switch for the generative AI upgrade — you can only adjust speech rate or opt out of specific features like summarized news.

steps.path: Alexa app → More → Settings → Alexa Responses → adjust speech rate to faster
Alexa app → More → Settings → Brief Mode → toggle on (shorter responses, but does not disable generative AI)
Amazon account → Manage Your Content and Devices → Alexa → opt out of specific AI features where available

collateral: there is no master toggle to revert Alexa to pre-generative-AI behavior
Brief Mode shortens responses but does not disable the underlying generative model
whyTheyDidIt: Amazon is repositioning Alexa as an AI assistant competitor to ChatGPT and Google Gemini.
